# GET /api/v1/notifications/threads/{id}

Get notification thread by ID

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-024`

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| id | path | string | True |

## Response

**200** — *NotificationThread

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | notification thread ID |
| `repository` | Repository | associated repository |
| `subject` | NotificationSubject | notification subject details |
| `unread` | bool | whether notification is unread |
| `pinned` | bool | whether notification is pinned |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Notification ID not found | 404 | not found | False |
| User is not owner and not admin | 403 | forbidden | False |

### Error Paths

- **Notification not found** → getThread → 404
- **Not owner and not admin** → getThread → 403
- **LoadAttributes fails (non-comment error)** → GetThread → 500
